candidates.description: A complete, character-level, single-segment operationalization of the repository's existing Vogt-derived exploratory hypothesis for the frozen 18-symbol evaluation inventory.
candidates.linguistic_rationale: Preserve each legacy single-character, single-segment Vogt value where available; make the previously missing EVA i and q assumptions explicit as /i/ and /q/; and reduce legacy multi-phone EVA o to its initial vowel /ae/ so every frozen basic-EVA character has exactly one auditable vector. This is an unscored completion hypothesis, not evidence that the assignments are correct.
differences_from_legacy: Uses deterministic one-character-to-one-segment parsing and disables all legacy multigraph/context patterns.
Adds explicit i to /i/ and q to /q/ assumptions because the legacy encoding has no values for those evaluation symbols.
Maps o to the legacy initial vowel /ae/ represented by IPA ae ligature, omitting the legacy following rhotic segment.
Uses canonical IPA symbols rather than legacy display aliases S, N, and superscript-t s.

normalization.case_treatment: preserve frozen uncapitalized Takeshi Takahashi H layer
normalization.uncertain_symbols: exclude whole tokens containing star, question-mark, extended, or non-basic EVA forms under the pinned evaluation-inventory policy

segmentation.method: consume one accepted basic-EVA character as one phonological segment
segmentation.overlap_resolution: not applicable; characters are consumed left-to-right without multigraph replacement

transcription_ambiguities.rationale: The legacy Vogt encoding has no i rule; this transparent completion is explicit and requires researcher approval.
The legacy Vogt encoding has no q rule; this transparent completion is explicit and requires researcher approval.

transcription_ambiguities.treatment: map to /ae/ represented by IPA ae ligature
transcription_ambiguities.rationale: The legacy o rule emits a vowel followed by a rhotic vector; the proposal retains only its initial vowel to satisfy the frozen one-vector-per-symbol contract.
This preserves the legacy single-character values while making their phonological merger explicit.

transcription_ambiguities.treatment: exclude the complete token before mapping
transcription_ambiguities.rationale: The frozen evaluation inventory reports ten such tokens and does not silently map or drop individual unknown characters.
